technology_name: AN INTEGRATED BEAM CHOPPING AND STEERING SYSTEM USING A LINEAR OPTICAL CHOPPER AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard mechanical beam-choppers are heavy, bulky, lack precision control at ultra-high frequencies, and require hardware modifications to alter the modulation frequency window. This system combines both chopping and steering dynamically in a single miniature layout.
description: An integrated dual-functional optoelectronic beam modulation and steering system utilizing an ultra-low weight linear optical chopper head with custom-spaced micro-apertures to control beam duty cycles from 1% to 99% via wireless control modules.
applications: Laser spectroscopy, automated optical sorting networks, lidar scanning assemblies for drones/robotics, and high-speed optical communications equipment.
